scaled.name: Option A: Enhanced Scaled Transformer
scaled.architecture: Pre-LN Scaled Transformer with Weight Tying

sample_translations_comparison.linguistic_notes: The scaled model correctly learned the words for 'Former' (ପୂର୍ବତନ) and 'Minister' (ମୁଖ୍ୟମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ/ମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ). The baseline just produced generic filler text instead.

sample_translations_comparison.source: The residents of the locality are in a state of panic after the incident.
sample_translations_comparison.reference: ଏହି ଘଟଣା ପରେ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଲୋକେ ଉତ୍ତେଜନା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିଛନ୍ତି।
sample_translations_comparison.baseline_output: ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ ପୁଲିସ୍ ପକ୍ଷରୁ କୌଣସି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ମିଳିପାରି ନାହିଁ।
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_greedy: ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ ପୁଲିସ୍ତାନାନେ ପ୍ରକାରୀଙ୍କୁ ଗ୍ୟାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଛି।
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_beam: ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ ପୁଲିସ୍ଥିତ୍ରେ ଏହି ମାମଲାରୁ ଘଟିଛି ।
sample_translations_comparison.linguistic_notes: Both models correctly translated 'after the incident' (ଏହି ଘଟଣାରେ). The scaled model with beam search kept the sentence structure cleaner.

sample_translations_comparison.source: But how is it even possible?
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_greedy: କିନ୍ତୁ କିଛି କିଛି କି କିଛି... (repetition trap)
sample_translations_comparison.scaled_beam: କିନ୍ତୁ କିଛି କି କେହାକୁ କେ ? (blocked repetition)
sample_translations_comparison.linguistic_notes: Shows why repetition blocking matters: greedy decoding gets stuck looping on short words, while beam search finishes cleanly.
